text:
maya: Heads-up — quantization kernel rollout for Dedicated is slipping ~2w due to a driver regression blocking the int8 path. Need to re-evaluate v1 scope/cuts. Quick huddle? :eyes:
liam: Which models/runtimes are impacted and which customer pilots are at risk?
maya: A100 int8 path blocked. Affects redwood-quant-v1 variants and any workloads we planned to pin for Dedicated. Acme pilot + BetaHealth pilot will see throughput regression.
chen: Confirmed. Infra estimates fix earliest 2026-05-10, plus ~5 business days for testing/canary — roughly a 2-week slip.
zoe: Draft cut proposals: 1) Keep embeddings cache + SLA validation (blocking) 2) Defer tenant-routing and advanced rollout controls to v1.1 3) Defer analytics UI polish and non-blocking UX items
andre: Strong +1 on deferring telemetry pipeline changes too — low customer value for launch, higher risk.
sam: We promised BetaHealth a May pilot. If we cut tenant-routing, CS needs a one-pager and revised success criteria.
maya: Agreed. Proposed cutlist (quick):
```
- Keep: embeddings cache, core SLA checks, basic model pinning
- Defer to v1.1: tenant-scoped routing, advanced rollout (A/B), analytics dashboards
- Consider as optional canary: autopin heuristics, granular rate-limit UI
```
liam: Roadmap action: shift v1 milestone from 2026-05-24 -> 2026-06-07 (soft target) and add "customer comms" task. Can infra scope smoke tests earlier?
zoe: I'll update the milestone board, add the "canary gating" ticket and mark scope changes. Notes: https://confluence.redwood/scope-cascade
product-bot: Meeting scheduled: scope-huddle today 15:30 PT. Invite sent to @eng-runtime @customer-success
maya: Please flag objections to the cutlist before 15:00. If none, we'll lock the list and notify customers. :white_check_mark:
liam: No objections from infra; we'll prioritize smoke tests on the hotfix path.
chen: I'll draft the customer one-pager and tag CS for review.
sam: I'll stitch a rollback checklist/playbook in case Dedicated capacity regresses during canary.
zoe: :thumbsup:
maya: Locking cutlist at 15:00 unless there are blockers. Thanks team!
